# bioexcel/biobb_pytorch/mdfeaturizer

## Summary

Obtain the Molecular Dynamics Features for PyTorch model training.

Obtain the Molecular Dynamics Features for PyTorch model training.

Nextflow adapter of the [MDFeaturePipeline](https://biobb-pytorch.readthedocs.io/en/latest/mdae.html#module-biobb_pytorch.mdae.mdfeaturizer) building block of [biobb_pytorch](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_pytorch) 5.3.0.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_PYTORCH_MDFEATURIZER } from 'bioexcel/biobb_pytorch/mdfeaturizer'

workflow {
    BIOBB_PYTORCH_MDFEATURIZER(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_topology_path` | yes | pdb | Path to the input topology file |
| `input_trajectory_path` | no | xtc, dcd | Path to the input trajectory file (if omitted topology file is used as trajectory) |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_dataset_pt_path` | yes | pt | Path to the output dataset model file |
| `output_stats_pt_path` | yes | pt | Path to the output model statistics file |
| `versions_biobb_pytorch` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_pytorch', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of MDFeaturePipeline properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_dataset_pt_path: 'pt']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_pytorch container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_PYTORCH_MDFEATURIZER' {
        ext.properties = [cartesian: [selection: 'name CA']]
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cartesian` | object | {"selection": "name CA"} | Atom selection options for Cartesian coordinates feature generation (e.g. selection, fit_selection). |
| `distances` | object | {"selection": "name CA", "cutoff": 0.4, "periodic": true, "bonded": false} | Atom selection options for pairwise distance features (selection, cutoff, periodic, bonded, etc.). |
| `angles` | object | {"selection": "backbone", "periodic": true, "bonded": true} | Atom selection options for angle features (selection, periodic, bonded, etc.). |
| `dihedrals` | object | {"selection": "backbone", "periodic": true, "bonded": true} | Atom selection options for dihedral features (selection, periodic, bonded, etc.). |
| `options` | object | {"norm_in": {"mode": "min_max"}} | General processing options (e.g. timelag, norm_in). |
